*Observations*
• Pod `billing-api-5bb7c966cf-x2fbp` logs repeatedly report `WARN db connection reset by peer, retrying (pool acquire ...)`.
• Deployment `billing-api` sets `DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` to `900`, whereas DBProxy `billing-db-proxy` sets `spec.idleClientTimeout` to `600`.
• Runbook `RB-014` dictates the application pool must recycle idle connections before the shortest intermediate network timeout.

*Ruled-out leads*
• Memory exhaustion was ruled out because heap usage is at 41% (212 MB / 512 MB) and connection wait times drive the pressure.
• Pod crash or restarts were ruled out because the pod status is `Running` with zero restarts.

*Root cause*
The database connection pool idle timeout (900s) exceeds RDS DBProxy's idle client timeout (600s), causing the proxy to close idle connections.

*Recommended action*
Team Platform should update `DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` in Deployment `billing-api` below 600s (e.g., 300s) or raise `spec.idleClientTimeout` on `billing-db-proxy`.
